l.i: Deus Verbum ipse ex proprio lumine super-
naturalis, beatæque suæ naturæ emittit natura-
liter secundum propriam existentiam Spiritum
sanctum. Nanque haud fieri potest, vt aliquid
ex lumine alicuius appareat, & non naturali-
ter, & indiuise, & inexhauste inde effundatur,
& tanquam illi coëxistens, & coœuum, & vti
verus homo hic idem diuinam præeminentiam
huius sancti Spiritus viua voce multimode re-
uelauit suis discipulis, sed non seruili modo, vti
quicunque ex nostris sanctus, quod non purus
homo erat ipse, sed Deus Verbum incarnatum
diuino quodam modo, vti ex proprio lumine
superdiuinæ suæ Deitatis effundens illum, vt
ex fonte, promens nempe illum naturaliter.

page.notes: Printed text is set in italic throughout; the Greek words φαίνω are in Greek letters as printed. The line ending "præeminentiam" carries a dash-like stroke, not a printed hyphen, so the word is written whole. "ijsque" is a doubtful reading ([?]). The line "triфariam" is a misreading of the Greek letter in the scan: the printed word is "trifariam", and the Greek phi was copied in error, so treat the word as "trifariam". Catchword "tri-" is the start of the next page's word. Page has no running head.
